mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO sys_user_block (user_id, blocked_user_id, created_at, create_by, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{blockedUserId}, NOW(), 'app-user-center', NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sys_user_block WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND blocked_user_id = #{blockedUserId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user_block WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND blocked_user_id = #{blockedUserId}

SELECT u.user_id, u.nick_name, u.avatar, u.bio, u.user_type, 0 AS is_following FROM sys_user_block b JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = b.blocked_user_id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} AND u.del_flag = '0' AND u.user_type IN ('01', '02', '03') ORDER BY b.created_at DESC, b.id DESC
